title: Prove retained packet backing at prefix-return cuts
body:
PR2697 clears per-prefix payload buffers without dropping their bindings. At the next prefix read, those backing arrays coexist with the directory, the retained Consumer preflight prefix, the previous prefix and the new return value. This package proves the exact identity-aware sum at that common cut, including the first-pass source/current alias and stale bindings across primitive passes.

For N prefixes of F payload symbols, source backing K, directory backing D and prefix backing Q (all including LEFT), the initial cut is K+1+D+2Q. Every later cut is K+[t>0](NF+1)+(jF+1)+(1+delta)(F+1)+D+3Q, where delta describes the previous action's changed/local alias relation. The native distinct-output case has maximum K+(2N+1)F+4+D+3Q over these return cuts when at least two primitive passes run. This is a named-root component, not a global peak, complete caller reserve, physical allocator theorem or new kappa.

**Evidence:** registered Python 3.12 replay and exact committed-byte verification pass; a read-only, Git-free optimized Python 3.14 replay passes all three commands. The primary checker covers 130 cuts with actual small sign primitives and an actual Consumer preflight/toy-payload seam. A separately derived checker covers 5,184 cuts in 864 cases with alternating alias contracts and padded backing. Accounting, source/manifest, preload, domain and typed-receipt defect controls pass. All 23 source exports match their original Git bytes. Finite fixtures are not full selected GL64 execution, formal-kernel proof or independent human review; hosted CI is separate.

Source: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml PR2697 a53fdf4bcbe33c6732f0bec1badc8c023380f9d1. Credit starship-s PR2731 for the distinct nonblank-payload result, Nick Petalas PR2743 for caller payload/key composition, and the released field-producer / Program-acceptance handoffs d1881858 / dec8964b. The predecessor's D+3Q prefix-only result is not claimed anew. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including a separate math-storage-lifetimes AI derivation and cross-review; Apache-2.0 notices retained.

Canonical investigation: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18965395
Scientific base d4cf4ebcba259993b34f91af6f7b89419927ca57, priority5. Submission refresh 67b122d33d6c599a49f65d50afa2f3fe8d790d02 leaves guidance, selected record and replay tools unchanged; the additive patch applies cleanly.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-packet-retained-backing`.

Next: join the other caller owners at the same cuts, cover primitive interiors, and supply a physical last-borrower/reuse contract. This session stops at the present component; no selected-frontier change.

Submission overlap at 06:20 UTC: 495 open PRs including drafts, 2,077 closed/merged PRs and 1,516 Discussion records, with complete metadata pagination and no warnings; 2,541 local records were searched. Snapshot times are separate (06:15:47 / 06:20:01 / 06:19:31 UTC), not atomic. The helper excludes arbitrary diffs and unpublished work; no novelty guarantee. The 47-comment/6-reply canonical thread was also freshly checked.
